changed.change: Replace base-year peak delay extrapolation with analysis-year travel time and volume, retaining AM/PM, 365-day annualization, project links and reduction factors.
Sum period volumes for daily traffic, retain project links and annualization, convert source seconds to output hours, and carry Year through spatial formulas.

retained.reason: Project-level crash-growth methodology explicitly operates without TDM; switching to model-based exposure requires choosing a matched baseline/link/VMT aggregation method.
The no-build crash projection must stay consistent with KPI 5; its existing link-to-zone aggregation is unresolved.

The existing project-volume expression contains an unbound Link, and Saved Minutes applies to diverted trips. Summing link volumes would not identify unique diverted trips and could double count; new links may also lack KPI 103 base anchors.

otherGrowthRates: Bike/ped trip growth and health/amenity growth are not vehicle-volume growth and remain unchanged.
